instruction: Knees align with the machine's pivot point. Lower pad just above the ankle. Control the movement/tempo.

name: Leg Press - TG
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Align hip|| knee|| foot before push. Go down controlled.

name: March - Wall Drill
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the glute. Keep a straight line from head to toe and 45 degree from the floor|| Avoid movement of the trunk.

name: March in the place
instruction: Strong tall posture when on one leg.

name: Mid-Thigh High Pull - BB
instruction: Bar at mid-thigh level. Hinge hips back slightly, torso over the bar. Strong push through the floor, extending hips, knees, ankles. As you extend do aggressive vertical pull up to sternum level.

name: Mid-Thigh Pull - BB
instruction: Bar at mid-thigh level. Hinge hips back slightly, torso over the bar. Strong push through the floor, extending hips, knees, ankles. As you extend do aggressive vertical shrug. Arms stay extended.

name: Mobility Squat
instruction: Decent to the position where the backs of your thighs come into contact with the backs of your calves and challenge that position with various movements.

name: Mountain Climber
instruction: High plank position, core braced. Body in a straight line from head to heels. Drive the knees towards the chest in alternating fashion with rhythm.

name: Multidirectional Lunge - BB
instruction: Place the barbell on your upper back, then lunging forward, to the side, and backward in a controlled sequence on each leg, keeping your torso upright and core engaged throughout.

name: Multidirectional Lunge - BW
instruction: Chest up and core engaged. Step forward, sideways, and backward with control, keeping your knee aligned with your foot. Push back to the start position after each lunge, maintaining balance and posture throughout.

name: Multidirectional Lunge - WB
instruction: Chest up and core engaged. Step forward, sideways, and backward with control, keeping your knee aligned with your foot. Push back to the start position after each lunge, maintaining balance and posture throughout.

name: Narrow Bench Press - DB
instruction: Lay on the bench holding two dumbbells close together above your chest. Lower them with elbows tight to your sides, then press back up, focusing on triceps control.

name: Nordic Hamstring - NordBord
instruction: Chest out and strong core. Squeeze the glutes to avoid arching. Go down slowly as deep as you can

name: Nordic Hamstring - Partner
instruction: Chest out and strong core. Squeeze the glutes to avoid arching. Go down slowly as deep as you can.

name: Nordic Hamstring Hip Hinge - NordBord
instruction: Chest out and strong core. Squeeze the glutes to avoid arching. Go down slowly as deep as you can.

name: Offset RDL - TB
instruction: Stand tall holding a trap bar with one foot slightly behind (offset stance). Keep chest up and core tight, hinge at the hips, lowering the bar while maintaining a flat back. Drive through the front heel to return, focusing on glute and hamstring control.

name: OH BB Walk w Pelvic Lift
instruction: Hold the barbell overhead, core tight and glutes engaged to lift the pelvis. Walk forward with control, keeping the bar stable and hips aligned.

name: OH Split Squat - MB
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Back leg toes remain on the floor all time. Squeeze the back leg glute for the whole movement. Be nice and tall.

name: OHP - DB
instruction: Press the dumbbells from shoulder position above your head (close to fully extended arms)|| while maintaining the ready position

name: OHP - DI
instruction: Press the dumbbells from shoulder position above your head (close to fully extended arms)|| while maintaining the ready position

name: Oscillation Goblet Squat
instruction: Hold a weight close to your chest in a goblet position. Lower into a squat and perform small, quick up-and-down pulses, keeping your core tight and chest up throughout.

name: Overhead Squat - BB
instruction: Hold the barbell overhead with arms locked out and core tight. Lower into a squat, keeping the bar stable, chest up, and knees aligned with your feet, then return to standing with control.

name: Partner Accel Challenge - IB
instruction: Start in an incline position with your partner providing light resistance with the elastic band. Drive forward explosively, maintaining a strong core and forward lean, challenging acceleration mechanics under tension.

name: Partner Back to Back Combat [sitting]
instruction: Sit back-to-back with your partner, feet flat and knees bent. Press into each other, keeping your core engaged and posture tall throughout the hold.

name: Partner Back to Back Squat
instruction: Stand back-to-back with your partner, arms crossed over your chest. Lower together into a squat and rise in sync, keeping contact, core tight, and movement controlled throughout.

name: Partner Back to Back Squat Combat
instruction: Sit back-to-back with your partner in a squat position, feet flat and knees at 90°. Maintain tension by pressing into each other, keeping your core tight and chest up throughout.

name: Partner Crawl Takedown
instruction: Start in a bear crawl position facing your partner. On cue, crawl forward and attempt to off-balance or gently pull your partner to the ground, using controlled force. Stay low, core engaged and react quickly.

name: Partner Decel Challenge - IB
instruction: Start in an incline position with your partner providing light resistance with the elastic band. Drive backward explosively, maintaining a strong core and forward lean, challenging acceleration mechanics under tension.

name: Partner Lateral Challenge - IB
instruction: Face sideways with the iso belt around your waist and partner providing resistance. Step laterally against the tension, keeping your core tight, hips low, and movement controlled.

name: Partner MB Squat Throw
instruction: Face your partner, both in a squat position. Simultaneously squat and throw the medicine ball to each other, keeping the core tight and movement explosive.

name: Partner Pull Combat - PB
instruction: Face your partner, each holding one end of the power band. Pull with force in opposite directions, keeping your stance strong, core tight, and controlling the movement during the struggle.

name: Partner Resisted Acceleration [front]
instruction: Lean forward with your partner holding a band in front for resistance. Drive forward with powerful steps, keeping your core tight and body in a strong acceleration posture.

name: Partner Resisted A-Skip - PB
instruction: With the band around your waist and partner resisting, perform A-skips forward, driving knees high and staying tall and controlled.

name: Partner Resisted High Knees [in place] - PB
instruction: While partner pulls you with power-band backward|| run with high knee in the place. Stay tall and maintain short ground contact (think of ground is hot).

name: Partner Resisted High Knees [run] - PB
instruction: With the band around your waist and partner behind, run in place with high knees. Keep posture tall, core tight, and drive the arms and legs with speed against the resistance.

name: Partner Resisted Lateral Bound - PB
instruction: With the band around your waist, perform explosive lateral bounds, staying low and controlling each landing against your partner's resistance.

name: Partner Resisted March [in place] - PB OH
instruction: With the power band overhead and your partner holding the other end, march in place, driving your knees high against the resistance, keeping your core tight and posture strong.

name: Partner Resisted March [walk] - PB OH
instruction: With the power band overhead and your partner holding the other end, march forward, driving knees high and maintaining a strong posture, while resisting the band's tension.

name: Partner Shoulder to Shoulder Combat
instruction: Stand side by side with your partner, shoulders touching. Push against each other using controlled force, staying low, core engaged, and maintaining balance throughout the movement.

name: Pigeon Pose Stretch
instruction: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you, shin angled, and the other leg extended straight back. Keep your hips square and gently lean forward over the front leg to stretch the hip.

name: Plate Reaching Squat - DI
instruction: Hold a weight plate close to your chest. As you squat down, extend the plate forward at shoulder height. Keep your core tight, back straight, and use the reach to help with balance and posture.

name: Power Clean - BB
instruction: Lift the bar from your middle-thighs, explode through your hips, and catch it on your shoulders in a front squat. Stand tall to finish.

name: Prisoner Split Squat - BW
instruction: Stand in a split stance with hands behind your head. Lower into a squat, keeping your chest up, then push through your front heel to return. Switch legs after reps.

name: Prisoner Squat - BW
instruction: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands behind your head. Squat down, keeping your chest up and core tight, then push through your heels to return to standing.

name: Prone Back Extension [diagonal]
instruction: Lie face down with one arm extended overhead and the opposite leg straight back. Lift both diagonally, squeezing your glutes and back, then lower with control. Alternate sides.

name: Prone Back Extension Y
instruction: Lie face down with arms extended overhead in a Y shape. Lift your chest and arms off the ground, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower back down with control.

name: Pull Up
instruction: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart. Pull your chest up toward the bar by engaging your back and arms, then lower down with control.

name: Pull Up - PB assisted
instruction: Hang with an overhand grip, then pull your chest up toward the bar, using the band for assistance. Lower with control.

name: Pull Up - Rings
instruction: Hang from the rings with a neutral grip (palms facing each other). Pull your chest up by engaging your back and arms, keeping the movement controlled, then lower slowly to full extension.

name: Pull Up [ECC]
instruction: Jump or step up to the top position of a pull-up, then slowly lower yourself down with control over 3–5 seconds to full extension.

name: Pull Up [ISO hold]
instruction: Pull yourself up and hold at the top position with your chin above the bar. Keep your core tight and shoulders engaged, maintaining the hold for the desired time.

name: Push & Jerk - BB
instruction: Start with the barbell at shoulder height. Dip slightly by bending your knees, then drive up explosively, pushing the bar overhead while splitting or bending your legs to catch it. Stand tall to finish.

name: Push Throw to Wall - MB
instruction: Hold the medicine ball at chest level. Dip slightly, then explosively push and throw the ball forward into the wall, extending your arms fully. Catch or reset and repeat.

name: Push Up
instruction: Start in a plank position with hands under shoulders. Lower your chest to the floor by bending your elbows, keeping your body straight. Push back up to the starting position.

name: Push Up - DI
instruction: Place a disc on your back and assume a push-up position. Lower your chest to the ground, keeping your body straight, then push back up, maintaining control and stability throughout the movement.

name: Push Up - Rings
instruction: Starting with your arms straight and scapular engaged, lower your body in between the rings by bending your arms. Keep your elbows close to your sides as you descend, and stop once your chest is at the same level as your hands. Push back up to the starting position, keeping your elbows pointed backwards the entire time.

name: Push Up & Roll Out - BB
instruction: Perform a push-up with hands on a barbell. At the top, drop to your knees and roll the bar forward, keeping your core tight. Pull it back in, return to plank, and repeat.

name: Push Up [feet elevated] - Rings
instruction: Place your feet up on a box with your arms straight and scapular engaged, lower your body in between the rings by bending your arms. Keep your elbows close to your sides as you descend, and stop once your chest is at the same level as your hands. Push back up to the starting position, keeping your elbows pointed backwards the entire time.

name: Push Up Diamond
instruction: Position your index fingers and thumbs in a diamond shape under your chest|| and extend your arms to elevate your body. Lower your chest towards your hands and keep your back flat then push back up to the starting position.

name: Push Up Fly
instruction: Keeping your body in a nice straight line, lower your chest to the ground, quickly push back up from the bottom of the push up, exploding up off the ground at the top. Lift your feet and hands up off the ground. As you land, bend your elbows and quickly sink right back to the bottom of the Push Up before exploding back up off the ground.

name: Push Up Jump
instruction: Keeping your body in a nice straight line, lower your chest to the ground, quickly push back up from the bottom of the push up, exploding up off the ground at the top. Lift your hands up off the ground. As you land, bend your elbows and quickly sink right back to the bottom of the Push Up before exploding back up off the ground.

name: Push Up to Acceleration
instruction: Keeping your body in a nice straight line, lower your chest to the ground, quickly push back up from the bottom of the push up, accelerating for 10m.

name: Push Up to Side Plank
instruction: Hands under the shoulders, feet a bit wider. Perform Push-up and as you lift, shift balance to one hand and take side plank position for a second. Be stable.

name: Push Up w Clap
instruction: Place hands and feet wider than shoulder width. Chest out and core strong. Push as strong and fast that you can with the aim of take off your hand from the ground.

name: Push Up w Shoulder Tap
instruction: Place hands and feet wider than shoulder width. Chest out and core strong. Squeeze glutes to avoid arching the lower back. Keep trunk and pelvis fixed.

name: Quad - FoamRoller
instruction: Search trigger points and push on it keeping the pressure constant. Scale of pain out of 10 never more than 8 release it until 3-4.

name: Quadruped Pelvic Tilts
instruction: Close eyes and focus only on hip movement. Make sure do not move other part of body except hip. Move slowly.

name: Quadruped Scapula Protraction&Retraction
instruction: Close eyes and focus only on upper back movement. Make sure do not move other part of body except upper back. Move slowly.

name: Quarter Back Squat - BB
instruction: Dip under the bar to put it behind the neck across the top of the back, and grip the bar with the hands wider than shoulder-width apart. Lift the chest up and squeeze the shoulder blades together to keep the straight back throughout the entire movement. Lower your body until your knees are bent at about a 45-degree angle.

name: RDL - BB
instruction: Begin the downward movement by lowering the bar slowly, making sure that the bar remains as close as possible to the body. As the bar is lowered, the hips flex and move backward, the knees remain slightly flexed and the shoulders move forward and remain directly over, or in front of, the bar. Once the bar reaches its lowest point, instead of hinging at the hip and bringing the barbell back into the hip, you will perform a clean and step forward onto a box.

name: RDL - KB
instruction: Begin the downward movement by lowering the kettlebell slowly. As the kettlebell is lowered, the hips flex and move backward, the knees remain slightly flexed and the shoulders move forward and remain directly over. Once the kettlebell reaches its lowest point, extend the hips to begin the upward movement. The hips move forward as they extend, while the shoulders move backward as the torso moves toward the vertical position.

name: RDL - Landmine
instruction: Stand with a bar in between your legs and lay the bar in the notch of a v-bar with both hands on the handle. Stand tall and begin the RDL by pushing your hips back and hinging forward until the bar is just below knee height. Drive through the whole foot and focus on pushing the floor away.

name: RDL - TB
instruction: Stand inside of the trap bar with a hip width stance. Assume a neutral grip on the handles and deadlift the weight into position at the top with the hips and knees locked out. Begin the RDL by pushing your hips back and hinging forward until the bar is just below knee height. Drive through the whole foot and focus on pushing the floor away.

name: RDL Clean to Box - BB
instruction: Begin the downward movement by lowering the bar slowly, making sure that the bar remains as close as possible to the body. As the bar is lowered, the hips flex and move backward, the knees remain slightly flexed and the shoulders move forward and remain directly over, or in front of, the bar. Once the bar reaches its lowest point, instead of hinging at the hip and bringing the barbell back into the hip, you will perform a clean and step forward onto a box.

name: RDL Clean to Box Step Up - BB
videoUrl: https://iamaspire.aspire.qa/ExerciseVideo/RDL Clean to Box Step Up - BB.mp4
instruction: Begin the downward movement by lowering the bar slowly, making sure that the bar remains as close as possible to the body. As the bar is lowered, the hips flex and move backward, the knees remain slightly flexed and the shoulders move forward and remain directly over, or in front of, the bar. Once the bar reaches its lowest point, instead of hinging at the hip and bringing the barbell back into the hip, you will perform a clean and step forward onto a box and step up.

name: Reverse Crunch
instruction: Bend your legs at the knee and brace your abs to slowly raise your legs so the knees are directly over your hips and your lower legs are parallel to the floor (bent 90 degrees). Contract the abs as you exhale to curl your hips and knees toward your chest, with only your hips coming off the floor as you curl. Return slowly to the starting position as you inhale, with your knees over your hips still bent 90 degrees.

name: Reverse Lunge - BB
instruction: Elevate your chest and brace your core by tensing your abdominal muscles. Initiate the movement by stepping straight back with one foot, keeping the other foot firmly planted. As you step back, maintain a vertical alignment to prevent any sideways shift that could disrupt your balance.

name: Reverse Nordic - BW
instruction: Start in a tall knee position and slowly lean backwards as far as you can without falling and keeping a neutral hip angle. Keep the core braced to hold a neutral spine.

name: Reverse Nordic - DI
instruction: Start in a tall knee position, holding the disc, and slowly lean backwards as far as you can without falling and keeping a neutral hip angle. Keep the core braced to hold a neutral spine.

name: Reverse Step w Row - KS
instruction: Simultaneously step backward with one foot while pulling the handle towards your torso, keeping your elbows close to your body. Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the peak of the movement. Step forward to the starting position while extending your arms back to the initial position.

name: Reverse to Forward Lunge - BB
instruction: Begin by shifting forward and powerfully pushing off the ground with your back leg, while straightening the front knee and hip.

name: Rolling Squat - DI
instruction: Stand up with your feet shoulder-width apart holding the disc. Bend your knees and press your hips back, until the glutes touch the floor. Roll back with your knees bent. Roll forward into the squat position and stand up.

name: Rollout - BB
instruction: Start in a tall kneeling position with hands around shoulder width apart on bar, core engaged. Roll forward with the back straight, no arching, core tight and hips moving with the torso. Keep arms even, no rotation, bar path straight. Bar should be approximately shoulder height or slightly lower when extended.

name: Rollout [kneeling] - TRX
instruction: Kneel facing away from anchor point (under TRX) with your spine neutral, avoiding any rounding of the back. Squeeze your glutes and brace your core. Roll forward, keeping your arms straight and aligned with your body, back remains flat. Avoid letting your hips sag or rise in end position. Pull yourself back to the starting position by driving your elbows down and towards your knees. Inhale out, exhale while returning.

name: Rollout [standing] - TRX
instruction: Stand facing away from anchor point (under TRX). Feet hip-width apart and arms extended in front of you, holding handles with neutral grip. Brace your core and squeeze your glutes. Slowly lean forward, guiding the TRX handles above your head with straight arms. Form a straight line from head to heels, and avoid letting your lower back arch. Inhale as you roll out, and exhale while returning to the starting position.

name: Rope Climbing
instruction: Use a firm grip and engage your legs to push yourself upward. Keep your body aligned. Reach with your arms high as possible and lift your knees towards your chest high as possible then push and pull yourself upwards rep by rep.

name: Rope Jumping
instruction: Adjust rope, when you stand on its center, the handles reach your armpits. Keep your knees slightly bent. Jump lightly on the balls of your feet, keeping your heels off the ground. Rotate the rope with your wrists rather than swinging your arms. Keep elbows near your ribs. Minimize ground contact (Floor is lava). Avoid breaking too much in hips/knees/ankles.

name: Rotational Clean&Press - Landmine
instruction: Feet shoulder-width apart, slight bend in knees. Hinge forward, back straight and core tight. Grip the barbell with a neutral wrist. Drive through hips and legs to explosively lift the BB to chest height. Pivot on your back foot and rotate your torso toward the landmine. Switch hands during rotation then press the BB overhead, rotating your torso to face the direction of the press. Arm is fully extended. Lower the barbell back to the starting position and reset.

name: Rowing Machine - Concept2
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Push away front the big toe first. Pull back from you arms.

name: Run for Stick Catch - Partner
instruction: In athletic position, stand with your partner facing each other 3 to 5 meters apart holding the stick next to you. On a "go", quickly change and make sure grabbing the stick on time. Reset.

name: Running 15-15
instruction: Run with a predetermined pace/speed or cover a certain distance within 15 seconds, then rest for 15 seconds. Follow sets and reps from coach.

name: SA Bent Over Row - DB
instruction: Stay one big step away from bench. Lean forward and place your non-working arm on the bench, maintain a neutral spine by engaging your core muscles. Avoid rounding or excessively arching back. Grab the DB and pull upward by driving your elbow straight back, keeping it close to your torso. Focus on squeeze your shoulder blade at the top of the movement. Lower the DB back to the starting position in a slow and controlled manner

name: SA Bent Over Rows - Partner
instruction: Player A is in a push up position perpendicular to Player B. Player B grabs Player A's ankle, and performs rowing movement. Avoid rounding or excessively arching back. Pull upward by driving your elbow straight back, keeping it close to your torso. on squeeze your shoulder blade at the top of the movement. Lower partner's leg back to the starting position in a slow and controlled manner.

name: SA Clean and Split Jerk - Landmine
instruction: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart. Focus on extending your hips and knees at the same time, explode through the hips. Pull the elbow up and out. Quickly drop under, keeping the bar close. Dip: Shallow dip, chest tall. Drive: Explode through the legs. Split: Quick split, front knee bent. Lock Out: Arm fully extended, head through. Step front foot back, then rear foot forward. Ensure balance before lowering bar.

name: SA Horizontal Row - FW[V12]
instruction: Stand tall, knees slightly bent, keep core tight. Grab handle firmly, palm facing inward. Pull handle to torso, elbow close to body. Squeeze shoulder blade, row back. Control the return, resist the flywheel.

name: SA Horizontal Row w Rotation - FW[V12]
instruction: Stand tall, feet stable, knees slightly bent, core tight. Hold handle with one hand, palm facing inward. Row back with elbow close, rotate torso. Squeeze shoulder blade and rotate to the side. Twist torso as you pull, not just the arm. Control the return, resist the flywheel. Keep chest open, avoid collapsing.

name: SA Kettlebell Swing - KB
instruction: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart, slight bend in knees. Hold kettlebell with one hand, palm facing inward. Push hips back, not down, keeping back straight. Drive hips forward, swing kettlebell overhead. Let the kettlebell drop between legs, hinge again. Exhale as you swing up, inhale on the way down. Keep chest up, shoulders back, avoid rounding lower back.

name: SA Push Jerk - Landmine
instruction: Stand tall, feet shoulder-width apart. Hold the barbell with one hand, elbow bent at 90°. Bend knees slightly, load your legs without leaning forward. Explosively extend through the legs, pressing the bar overhead. As you drive up, lock your arm and punch through. Fully extend your arm at the top, keeping a stable torso. Control the descent, lower bar with control back to starting position.a

name: SA Seated Row - FW[V12]
instruction: Sit tall, back straight, feet flat against machine. Grab the handle with one hand, palm facing inward. Brace your core, keep your chest lifted. Row handle toward your torso, elbow close to body. Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end of the movement. Slowly return the handle, resisting the flywheel.

name: SA Split Jerk - Landmine
instruction: Stand with feet hip-width apart. Hold the barbell with one hand, elbow bent. Bend knees slightly, load your legs without leaning forward too much. Explosively extend through the legs, press the bar overhead. As the bar moves up, split your legs, landing in a split stance position. Fully extend your arm and legs, keep core tight. Bring your feet back together after stabilizing the bar.

name: SA Split Stance Row - FW[D11]
instruction: Stand in a split stance, one foot on machine, one foot back. Grab the handle with one hand, palm facing inward. Brace your core, maintain a neutral spine. Pull the handle toward your torso, elbow close to your side. Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end of the movement. Slowly return the handle, resisting the flywheel.

name: Seated Calf Raise - SM
instruction: Sit on the box, balls of feet on box, knees at 90°, heels hanging off. Position the bar just above your thighs. Press through the balls of your feet, raise heels as high as possible. Squeeze your calves at the top of the movement. Lower your heels slowly, fully stretching the calves at the bottom. Keep your back straight and knees stationary throughout the movement.

name: Serape Push&Pull - KS
instruction: Maintain an athletic stance with a strong core and neutral spine. Push with one arm while simultaneously pulling with the other—focus on full range and control in both directions. Keep shoulders relaxed and rotate the torso.

name: Short Side Plank Clam - Miniband
instruction: Chest out|| squeeze glutes and core strong. Avoid rotation while open the leg. Keep the position at the end of movement for few seconds.

name: Short Side Plank w Hip Flexion
instruction: Chest out|| back straight. Actively squeeze core muscles. Toes up|| knee in front of your body during the movement. Straight line head to heel.

name: Short Side Plank w ISO Hip Flexion
videoUrl: https://iamaspire.aspire.qa/ExerciseVideo/Short Side Plank w ISO Hip Flexion.mp4
instruction: Chest out. Squeeze glutes and core strong. Shoulder and elbow same line. Hip remain high and rotated forward.

name: Shoulder Shrugs - DB
instruction: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms relaxed by your sides. Elevate your shoulders straight up toward your ears without rolling them. Pause briefly at the top, then lower under control—keep the neck relaxed throughout.

name: Side Lying Clam - Miniband
instruction: Avoid pelvis rotation. Move the knee up slowly. Reach as much as you can. Keep at the maximum point of tension for 3 to 5 seconds.

name: Side Plank
instruction: Chest out and keep back straight. Actively squeeze core muscles. Avoid movement of the hip and trunk. Keep always a straight line head to heel.

name: Side Plank [1 leg]
instruction: Chest out and keep back straight. Actively squeeze core muscles. Avoid movement of the hip and trunk during movement.

name: Side Plank ABD to ADD
instruction: Chest out|| back straight. Actively squeeze core muscles. Move from external to internal edge of your foot. Straight line head to heel.

name: Side Plank w DB Hold
instruction: Chest out|| squeeze glutes and core strong. Shoulder and elbow same line. Hip remain high and rotated forward. Keep the weight align with shoulder.

name: Side Plank w Hip ABD - Miniband
instruction: Chest out and keep back straight. Actively squeeze core muscles. Avoid movement of the hip and trunk during movement.

name: Side Plank w Hip Flexion - Miniband
instruction: Chest out|| back straight. Actively squeeze core muscles. Toes up|| knee in front of your body during the movement. Straight line head to heel.

name: Side Plank w Horizontal Row - KS
instruction: Chest out|| squeeze glutes and core strong. Shoulder and elbow same line. Avoid movement of shoulder and hip while you row. Move slowly.

name: Skater Jumps
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Align hip|| knee and ankle. Push violently off the ground laterally. Adjust the jump distance to allow you continuous rebounds from side to side.

name: Skater Jumps [weighted] - MB
instruction: Control the landing. Alignment of hip, knee, ankle. Avoid collapsing at the trunk. Load the hip. Repeat rhythmically from side to side.

name: Skull Crasher 1 - DB
instruction: Arms extended over the shoulders. Elbows stay still, forearms move. Controlled movement. Don't let elbows flare out.

name: Skull Crasher 2 - DB
instruction: Arms extended over the shoulders. Elbows stay still, forearms move. Controlled movement. Don't let elbows flare out.

name: SL Acceleration Squat - FW[V12]
instruction: Hold a box in front of your chest and perform a single-leg squat on the flywheel platform. Drive up explosively to accelerate the wheel, then control the return by resisting the eccentric force. Keep the core tight, knee aligned, and maintain a tall chest throughout.

name: SL Ankle Jumps
instruction: Stay tall and bounce repeatedly on one leg using only the ankle joint—minimal knee and hip movement. Focus on quick ground contact, stiffness, and rhythmic, elastic rebounds. Maintain balance and posture throughout the series.

name: SL Bent Over KB Lateral Swings - KB
videoUrl: https://iamaspire.aspire.qa/ExerciseVideo/SL Bent Over KB Lateral Swings - KB.mp4
instruction: Stand on one leg in a hinged position, holding the kettlebell with both hands. Swing the kettlebell side to side across the body while keeping hips stable and spine neutral. Engage the core to resist rotation and maintain balance throughout the movement.

name: SL Broad Jump - OJ
instruction: Start on one leg and perform an explosive horizontal jump, focusing on maximal distance. Land softly on the same leg with good knee and hip alignment, then stabilize before resetting. Use Optojump to measure jump distance and assess landing control.

name: SL Calf Raise - BW
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Push with the big toe the floor to raise the heel. Keep the ankle-foot in a neutral position.

name: SL Calf Raise - KS
instruction: Stand on one leg with the forefoot on the Keiser platform, heel off the edge. Press through the ball of the foot to lift the heel against resistance, then lower slowly under control. Keep the core engaged and avoid using momentum.

name: SL Calf Raise - SM
instruction: Stand on one leg with the forefoot on the platform, heel off the edge. Press through the ball of the foot to lift the heel against resistance, then lower slowly under control. Keep the core engaged and avoid using momentum.

name: SL Calf Raise [KneeExt] - TG
instruction: Position yourself on the calf raise machine with one leg, knee fully extended and forefoot on the platform. Push through the ball of the foot to lift the weight, then control the descent. Keep the core tight and avoid locking the knee or using momentum.

name: SL CMJ to Box [HoH]
instruction: Stand on one leg with hands on hips and perform a countermovement jump onto a box. Use a quick dip and drive to explode upward, landing softly and balanced on the same leg. Focus on vertical force production, controlled landing, and posture throughout.

name: SL Crab Hip Thrust - BW
instruction: Start in a crab position with feet flat and hands behind you, then lift one leg and drive hips upward. Squeeze the glutes at the top while keeping the lifted leg extended and hips level. Control the descent and avoid arching the lower back.

name: SL Glute Bridge
instruction: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat, the other leg extended. Drive through the heel to lift the hips, keeping them level and squeezing the glutes at the top. Control the movement on the way down—avoid arching the lower back or letting the hips drop

name: SL Glute Bridge Switch [fast] - hip ext.
instruction: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat on the ground, and arms at your sides. Lift your hips into a SL glute bridge position so your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees. Quickly switch legs. Lower the extended leg while lifting the other. Try to keep your hips stable during the transition.

name: SL Glute Bridge Switch [fast] - hip flex.
instruction: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat on the ground, and arms at your sides. Lift your hips into a SL glute bridge position so your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees. Quickly switch legs. Lower the extended leg while lifting the other. Try to keep your hips stable during the transition.

name: SL Hamstring Bridge Drop-Catch [long lever]
instruction: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat on the ground, and arms at your sides. Lift your hips into a SL glute bridge position so your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees. Quickly drop your hips down and brake it with SL before touchdown.

name: SL Hip Extension - TG
instruction: Adjust the machine so the pad sits just behind your thigh or heel. Press the leg back and up in a controlled arc, fully extending your hip. Focus on squeezing your glute at the top.

name: SL Hip Hinge - BW
instruction: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart. Shift your weight to one leg. keeping a slight bend in the knee. Send your butt back as you lower your torso forward. Keep your back straight!

name: SL Hip Hinge w Arms Reach
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Drive one leg all the way back. Straight line hands to feet. Drive the leg forward by squeezing the glute.

name: SL Hip Hinge w Stick
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Drive one leg all the way back. Straight line hands to feet. Drive the leg forward by squeezing the glute. Drive your arm forward

name: SL Hip Thrust - BB
instruction: Sit on the ground with your upper back against a bench or box. Drive through the heel of your grounded foot and thrust your hip up. Shift your weight to one leg. Lower under control, keeping the non-working leg extended and core engaged.

name: SL Hip Thrust - BW
instruction: Sit on the ground with your upper back against a bench or box. Drive through the heel of your grounded foot and thrust your hip up. Shift your weight to one leg. Lower under control, keeping the non-working leg extended and core engaged.

name: SL Hip Thrust - DI
instruction: Place the upper back on bench. Align the knee perpendicular and above the feet. Make sure the glute is used to push the plate. Push with the heel.

name: SL Hop over Hurdles [stick]
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Align hip|| knee and feet. Focus to push the ground as powerful as you can. Soft landing and push the knee out.

name: SL Lateral Hop over Hurdles [stick]
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Align hip|| knee and feet. Focus to push the ground as powerful as you can. Soft landing and push the knee out.

name: SL Lateral-Medial Hops
instruction: Single leg stance|| hop continuously left to right keeping a good posture|| core tight. Focus on the in line foot placement and slight knee bend

name: SL Leg Curl - TG
instruction: Adjust the seat so your knees align with the machine's pivot point. Position one leg in front of the pad. Curl your leg by contracting the hamstring. Control de

name: SL Leg Extension - TG
instruction: Adjust the seat so your knees align with the machine's pivot point. Position one leg behind the pad. Extend your leg by contracting the quadriceps. Control the descent back to the start position.

name: SL Leg Press - TG
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Align hip|| knee|| foot before push. Go down controlled.

name: SL Pistol Squat - BW
instruction: Stand tall on one leg. Lower yourself into a squat position. Keep the non-working leg extended and off the floor.

name: SL RDL - BB
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Drive one leg all the way back. Drive the leg forward by squeezing the glute. Keep a straight line from head to heel.

name: SL RDL - DB
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Drive one leg all the way back. Drive the leg forward by squeezing the glute. Keep a straight line from head to heel.

name: SL RDL - Landmine
instruction: Stand on one leg with a soft bend in the knee. Keep your chest up, shoulders back, and core braced. Hinge at the hip by extending one leg straight behind you for balance

name: SL RDL - Partner
instruction: Partner in a front plank position with arms extended. Standing at the partners back grab both ankles in front of your body. Unilaterally hinge your hip slowly

name: SL RDL Clean to Box - BB
instruction: Single leg deadlift. Finishes with a hang clean and high knee drive to the box

name: SL RDL to Hop [continuous]
instruction: Begin standing on 1 leg with the knee bended. Forward in your hips while the other leg starts to extend straight behind you. Lift your extended leg until your body forms a �T� shape. Hop fast in a vertical direction and land soft

name: SL RDL to Hop [stick]
instruction: Begin standing on 1 leg with the knee bended. Forward in your hips while the other leg starts to extend straight behind you. Lift your extended leg until your body forms a �T� shape. Hop fast in a vertical direction and land soft.

name: SL Seated Calf Raise - SM
instruction: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are at a 90-degree angle when your feet are on the platform. Place the balls of your feet on the platform and your thighs under the padded lever. Slowly raise your heels as high as possible while keeping your knees stationary.

name: SL Side Decel to Accel - Partner Push
videoUrl: https://iamaspire.aspire.qa/ExerciseVideo/SL Side Decel to Accel - Partner Push.mp4
instruction: Partner side pushing from the shoulders. while the other is trying to resist braking with contralateral leg followed by an acceleration speed in the intend direction.

name: SL Skater Squat - BW
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Drive the hip back and then knee forward. Touch the floor with the rear knee. Rear foot does not push the floor.

name: SL Skater Squat - SM
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Drive the hip back and then knee forward. Touch the floor with the rear knee. Rear foot does not push the floor.

name: SL Skater Squat [assisted] - BW
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Drive the hip back and then knee forward. Touch the floor with the rear knee. Rear foot does not push the floor.

name: SL Squat - KS
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Drive the hip back and then knee forward. Touch the floor with the rear knee. Rear foot does not push the floor.

name: SL Squat to Box - BW
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Drive the hip back. Drive the knee forward. Touch the box but do not sit down. Keep one leg on the air.

name: SL Squat to Box w Plate Reach - DI
videoUrl: https://iamaspire.aspire.qa/ExerciseVideo/SL Squat to Box w Plate Reach - DI.mp4
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Drive the hip back. Drive the knee forward. Push the weight out when you go down.

name: SL Stance Balance
instruction: Create foot arch and activate foot muscle. Avoid ankle movement. Big toe press the floor. Squeeze glute and core strong.

name: SL Zercher Squat - Landmine
instruction: Set the bar in the landmine rack at about stomach height. Now hook your arms underneath it so that the bar rests in the bend of your elbows. Squat unilaterally. Drive the hip back and then knee forward. Touch the floor with the rear knee. Rear foot does not push the floor.

name: Sled Accel to COD 180 Accel
instruction: Keep neutral spine and arms extended while pushing the sled. Focus on knee drive. Perform 180 degrees change of direction sprint

name: Sled Acceleration
instruction: Keep neutral spine and arms extended while pushing the sled. Focus on knee drive

name: Sled Back to Forward Accel
instruction: Keep neutral spine and arms extended while pushing the sled. Focus on knee drive. Push the sled forward then backwards

name: Sled Carioca Run
instruction: Stand sideways to the direction of travel. Pull the sled crossing your right foot over your left.

name: Sled Crawl Forward
instruction: Quadruped position. Pull the sled walking forward alternating your arms and legs.

name: Sled Crossover Lateral Run
instruction: Keep neutral spine and arms extended while pulling the sled laterally moving your leading leg over the other leg.

name: Sled Lateral Pull Alternating - T
instruction: Keep neutral spine and arms extended while pulling the sled side to side

name: Sled March
instruction: Keep neutral spine and arms extended while pushing the sled forward driving the knees up (walking)

name: Sled Push Crossover Accel
instruction: Keep neutral spine and arms extended while pushing the sled fast forward crossing your legs one over the other.

name: Snatch - SA DB
instruction: Overhand grip, grab a dumbbell in one hand and stand with the feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Descend your hips to the floor until your knees are bent at 90-degrees and the dumbbell is resting on the floor.Quickly pull the dumbbell toward the ceiling while simultaneously extending your knees and hips and raising your body on the balls of your feet

name: Spanish Squat - Belt
instruction: Place the belt at knee height.Stand upright with the knees slight bendet. Sit back into a 90 degrees squat position. Stand-up to the initial position

name: Spiderman Push Up
instruction: Chest out and core strong. Squeeze glutes to avoid arching the lower back. Try to keep an imagination line from head to feet.

name: Split Jerk - BB
instruction: Stance feet at a hip-width distance. Perform the dip bending only at your knees|| keeping your trunk vertical. After the dip drive forcefully with your legs while accelerating the barbell upward. Once legs extended|| move to stable split position.

name: Split Jerk - WB
instruction: Stance feet at a hip-width distance. Perform the dip bending only at your knees keeping your trunk vertical. After the dip drive forcefully with your legs while accelerating the waterbag upward. Once legs extended|| move to stable split position.

name: Split Squat - BB
instruction: Stand with a barbell resting on your shoulders and select a leg to be your front leg. Step backward with your non-selected leg and lower your body until your knee nearly touches the ground. Keep your front foot flat on the floor and rise back to the start position, driving through your heel

name: Split Squat - DB
instruction: Start with 1 knee on the floor, with front knee over ankle. Chest out and squeeze core. Stand up. On decent, back knee comes close to the floor.

name: Split Squat - FW[D11]
instruction: Start side on to the machine, chest out and squeeze core. Start to generate momentum. On decent back knee comes close to the floor. Power out the bottom.

name: Split Squat Jumps
instruction: Start at bottom of split squat. Explosively propel yourself skywards, using arms and legs. Land and brake quickly in same split squat position. Rebound back into the air.

name: Split Squat Jumps [alternating]
instruction: Start at bottom of split squat. Explosively propel yourself skywards, using arms and legs, switching legs in mid air. Land and brake quickly in same split squat position with opposite leg forward. Rebound back into the air, again switching legs.

name: Split Squat Knee Ext Reach
instruction: Start at bottom of split squat, with back knee off the floor. In braced and ready position, aggressively extend front leg to catch the floor with a long leg. Push of front leg, returning to start position.

name: Split Squat Knee Ext Taps
instruction: Start at bottom of split squat, with back knee off the floor. In braced and ready position, aggressively step front foot forward and punch back at speed for desired reps/ time.

name: Split Squat Knee Ext Taps to Drop Step Accel
videoUrl: https://iamaspire.aspire.qa/ExerciseVideo/Split Squat Knee Ext Taps to Drop Step Accel.mp4
instruction: In braced and ready position, aggressively step front foot forward and punch back at speed. On final step forward open hip and shoulders to push off in opposite direction.

name: Split Squat Knee Ext Taps to Side Step Accel
videoUrl: https://iamaspire.aspire.qa/ExerciseVideo/Split Squat Knee Ext Taps to Side Step Accel.mp4
instruction: In braced and ready position, aggressively step front foot forward and punch back at speed. Take final step out to the side, punching the floor away as you accelerate out on the angle.

name: Split Stance Switch Press - Landmine
instruction: Start with BB in 1 hand near shoulder. One leg forward in split stance, sitting hips slightly. Aggressively drive hips and switch legs, punching BB to full arm extension before returning to set position. Can start with same or opposite leg forward to BB arm.

name: Spooky Squat - BW
instruction: Stand on the balls of the feet. Flex at the knees. Lean upper body backward with arms extended in front, keeping balance. Return to standing, staying on balls of feet.

name: Spooky Squat - DI
instruction: Stand on the balls of the feet holding disc out in front of your chest. Flex at the knees. Lean upper body backward by bending at the knees. Return to standing, staying on balls of feet.

name: Spooky Squat on Incline Board
instruction: Stand on incline board on the balls of the feet. Flex at the knees. Lean upper body backward with arms extended in front, keeping balance. Return to standing, staying on balls of feet.

name: Spooky Walk - BW
instruction: Walk on the balls of the feet. Flex at the knees. Lean upper body backward with arms extended in front.

name: Spooky Walk - DI
instruction: Walk on the balls of the feet holding disc out in front of your chest. Flex at the knees. Lean upper body backward, maintaining balance.

name: Sprinter Lunge Jump
instruction: Start at bottom of split squat position. Explosively propel yourself skywards, using arms and legs. Punching back knee forward, switching and returning legs in mid air. Land and brake quickly in same split squat position.

name: Sprinter Plank - IB
instruction: With band around waist and feet shoulder width apart. Stay on toes, leaning forward to 45 degrees, keeping arms overhead. Keep tension through the body and maintain balanced position.

name: Sprinter Plank - Wall
instruction: Start standing away from the wall. Fall forward to block the wall at 45 degrees with a braced core and arms overhead. Push the wall away to return to standing.

name: Squat - TB
instruction: Big chest and brace core. Take slack from the bar, making body tight. Focus on pressing the floor away as you stand. Sit hips back as bar returns to the floor under control.

name: Squat Jump - BB
instruction: With bar on the back, big chest and brace core. Descend into squat position, set and then power out the bottom, jumping for height. Pull bar onto back and land softly.

name: Squat Jump - DB SA
instruction: Holding dumbbell in 1 hand, big chest and brace core. Descend into squat position, set and then power out the bottom, jumping for height. Land softly, returning to set position.

name: Squat Jump [ArmsFree]
instruction: Descend into squat position. Set and then power out the bottom, using arm and jumping for height. Land softly, returning to set position.

name: Squat Jump [HoH]
instruction: With hands on hips, descend into squat position. Set and then power out the bottom, keeping hands on hips and jumping for height. Land softly, returning to set position.

name: Squat Jump to Box
instruction: Standing in front of the box, descend into squat position. Set and then power out the bottom, using arm and jumping for height. Land softly on top of the box.

name: Squat to OHP - DI
instruction: Hold disc in 2 hands level with your chest. Descend into squat position, as you ascend to standing press the disc overhead. Return disc to chest level and repeat.

name: Squat Vertical Throw - MB
instruction: Hold medicine ball in 2 hands level with your shoulders. Dip and drive out of the squat, propelling the medicine ball overhead, as high as possible.

name: Squat w High Pull - FW[V12]
instruction: Hold handle in 2 hands, pulling cable to start flywheel. Violently drive out of the squat, pulling handle towards chest. Return to bottom of squat with arms long in timing with the flywheel and repeat at speed.

name: Staggered Quarter Squat - FW[D11]
instruction: With harness on, keep chest big and core strong. Begin to start the flywheel. Descend into squat, with weight over 1 leg. Drive through the floor, powering out of the bottom. Shift weight over to other leg as flywheel begins to pull you downwards.

name: Staggered Squat - Landmine
instruction: Leaning forward at a 45 degree angle, hold end of the barbell in 2 hands close to your upper chest. Beginning in a staggered stance, descend into squat position. Explode out of the bottom, driving through the hips, keeping bar close to chest.

name: Staggered Squat & Press - Landmine
instruction: Leaning forward at a 45 degree angle, hold end of the barbell in 2 hands close to your upper chest. Beginning in a staggered stance, descend into squat position. Explode out of the bottom, pressing the bar overhead.

name: Staggered Stance Deadlift - BB
instruction: Hold the barbell in 2 hands close to your hips. Begin in a staggered stance, keeping shoulders pulled back. Push hips back as bar decends. Once bar passes knees, bring knees forward over the bar. Continue to lower hips, descending until bar reaches the floor.

name: Staggered Stance Quarter Squat - BB
instruction: Hold the barbell in the back. Begin in a staggered stance, and descend into squat 90 degree angle and come back to initial position with control.

name: Staggered Stance RDL - BB
instruction: Hold the barbell in 2 hands close to your hips. Begin in a staggered stance, keeping shoulders pulled back. Push hips back as bar decends. Continue to lower hips, descending until bar close of the floor. Come back in standing position keeping the bar long the body

name: Staggered Stance RDL - TB
instruction: Hold the trapbar close to your hips. Begin in a staggered stance, keeping shoulders pulled back. Push hips back as bar decends. Continue to lower hips, descending until bar close of the floor. Come back in standing position keeping the bar long the body

name: Standing Cable Rotation - KS
instruction: Standing position, take the handle with two hands. Arms straight, pull the cable inwards (shoulders rotation) without moving the rest of the body. Return slowly in initial position.

name: Standing Horizontal Plate Press - DI
instruction: Standing position holding the plate in two hands, pushing the weight in horizontal until you stretch your arms. Return close of the chest under control without dropping the plate. Take care of your back (bend the legs)

name: Standing Knee Hug Stretch
instruction: Chest out|| move slowly and core strong. Do not lean backward. Drive the knee actively. Hold 5 seconds at maximum point of tension.

name: Standing Knee In&Out - Miniband
instruction: Push the knee out without moving the feet. Try to reach as much distance as you can. Stay few seconds at the end of movement.

name: Standing Leg Cradle Stretch
instruction: Chest out|| move slowly and core strong. Do not lean backward. Drive the knee actively. Hold 5 seconds at maximum point of tension.

name: Standing MB Slam - MB
instruction: Standing position with your Medecin ball in your hands. Hold the MB over your head and Throw it on the floor as fast as possible going down in squat position. Take it back and repeat.

name: Standing Torsion w YB - FW[V12]
instruction: Standing position, take the handle with two hands. hold the cable with both hands and the swissball in your arms, against your chest, Pull the cable inwards (shoulders rotation) and return with control. Repeat with tempo.

name: Star Excursion Balance Test
instruction: Keep ankle and knee stability. Create foot arch and activate foot muscle. Big toe press the floor. Move slowly and control the body.

name: Step Switches on Stepper
instruction: Using a step or hill|| start with one leg elevated. Keeping ankles stiff|| stay on balls of the feet and look to switch legs repeatedly at speed.

name: Stir the Pot - YB
instruction: Chest out and keep back straight. Actively squeeze core muscles. Avoid movement of the hip and trunk during fitball rotations.

name: Suitcase Carry - KB
instruction: Taking the kettlebell ( on your side) with one hand in squat position and walking with the KT with control

name: Superman Plank
instruction: Plank hands position: Chest out and keep back straight. Raise the outstretched arm until shoulder height and the opposite leg ( diagonal). Return slowly and change the side

name: Supine Active Hamstring Stretch
instruction: Keep lower back flat on the ground. Push your heel into the ground. Keep knee and ankle full extended. Hold at maximum point of tension for 5 seconds.

name: Supine Alternating Knee Drops Stretch
instruction: Push hands against the floor. Keep the shoulder on the floor and the legs together during the movement. Control the the legs during the movement.

name: Supine ASLR Stretch
instruction: Keep lower back flat on the ground all the time. Keep the knee and ankle full extended. Hold at maximum point of tension for 5 seconds.

name: Supine Shoulder Floor Slide
instruction: Lower back remain stable during whole exercise. Try to put elbows and wrists on the floor. Move slow. Breath out while hands go up.

name: Supine Vertical Throw - MB
instruction: Lie on your back with your legs bent. Hold the MB against your chest and throw it vertically with your arms outstretched. Catch it with control and repeat. Body remains stable during whole exercise

name: The Worlds Greatest Stretch
instruction: Lunge position. Place your hands on the ground in line with the front foot. Front knee is on the outside of the arms. Keep back knee off the ground. Look up|| keep your back straight. Lift your inside arm towards the sky. Keep a look on it

name: Tibialis Anterior - FoamRoller
instruction: Search trigger points|| push on it keeping the pressure constant. Scale of pain out of 10 never more than 8 release it until 3-4.

name: Toe Back Squat - BB
instruction: Hold the barbell in the back, standing position. Push on your toes and maintain the posture. Descend into squat and come back to initial position with control and keeping balance

name: Toe Squat - BW
instruction: Standing position on your toes. Descend in squat position with your arms outstretched. return keeping the balance.

name: Toe Squat - Landmine
instruction: On your Toes...Leaning forward at a 45 degree angle, hold end of the barbell in 2 hands close to your upper chest. Descend into toe squat position. Explode out of the bottom, driving through the hips, keeping bar close to chest. Keep toe squat position all long the exercice.

name: Toe Squat & Press - Landmine
instruction: On your Toes....Leaning forward at a 45 degree angle, hold end of the barbell in 2 hands close to your upper chest. Descend into toe squat position. Explode out of the bottom, pressing the bar overhead. Keep toe squat position all long the exercice.

name: Toe Walk
instruction: Chest out and squeeze the core. Raise the heel as high as possible during walking. Move slow and controlled.

name: Torsional Back to Wall Slams - MB
instruction: Start with feet shoulder width apart, slightly bent knees. Keeping your feet planted and not moving them, rotate and slam the ball into the wall with as much force as possible. Immediately catch the ball and twist to slam the ball the other side. Pivot at the hips, keeping the back upright - not allowing your back to bend.

name: Torsional Sprinter Plank - Wall
instruction: Start one step to the side of the wall. Take one step then drive the knee up and forwards. Focus on keeping a straight leg onto the floor as well as a 'big' chest creating a strong athletic position. Twist the torso so that both hands are flat against the wall.

name: Treadmill Running
instruction: Keep a constant rhythm. Breath in through your nose. Breath out through your mouth.

name: Triceps Bench Dips
instruction: Start by sitting on the bench, and slowly lift yourself off the bench with your legs at 90 degrees. Lower your body until your arms are now at 90 degrees and push back up to the starting position.

name: Triceps Dips
instruction: Start between two boxes with your knees bent. Lower your body until your arms are at 90 degrees and push back up to the starting position.

name: TRX Row [level 1]
instruction: Place your feet directly underneath the rings and the lean backwards. Focus on keeping the whole body in a straight line and not letting your hips drop. Pull all the way until your chest is level with the rings, then complete the movement by moving all the way to full straight arms.

name: TRX Row [level 2]
instruction: Place your feet one step forwards from underneath the rings and the lean backwards. Focus on keeping the whole body in a straight line and not letting your hips drop. Pull all the way until your chest is level with the rings, then complete the movement by moving all the way to full straight arms.

name: TRX Row [level 3]
instruction: Place your feet forward from the rings until your body is almost flat to the floor, and the lean backwards. Focus on keeping the whole body in a straight line and not letting your hips drop. Pull all the way until your chest is level with the rings, then complete the movement by moving all the way to full straight arms.

name: T-Spine Extension - FoamRoller
instruction: Place foam roller under scapula. Drive head back without arching lower back. Breath out slowly and hold for 5 seconds at maximum tension.

name: Tuck Jumps
instruction: Use your arms to help you jump as high as possible, and focus on getting your knees high at the top of the jump. Be reactive as possible off the floor and keep jumping to the same height everytime!

name: Turkish Get Up - KB
instruction: Keep your arm straight and above your head. Keep your hips high.

name: Upper Back - FoamRoller
instruction: Focus on rolling between the scapula. Hands behind neck. Scale of pain out of 10 never more than 8 release it until 3-4.

name: Upright Rows - BB
instruction: Start with slightly bent knees and a straight vertical back. As you pull the bar up, bend your elbows to the side allowing the bar to move straight up. Do not allow the back to bend - you will need to brace the core to achieve this. Control the descent of the bar and don't just let it drop.

name: V-Sit Vertical Throw - MB
instruction: Keep a V shape with your feet off the floor. Try to maintain this whilst throwing the ball, and touch the floor whilst the ball is in the air. Again, keep that position as you catch the ball - trying to increase how high the ball goes every throw!

name: Walk to Sprinter Plank - Wall
instruction: Start two steps back from the wall. Take one step then drive the knee up and forwards. Focus on keeping a straight leg onto the floor as well as a 'big' chest creating a strong athletic position.

name: Warm Up Combo - BW
instruction: This video is to help you warm up. You will not need any equipment. Just follow up.

name: Warm Up Combo DI-BB-KB
instruction: This video is to help you warm up. You will Olympic Barbell|| Disc (DI) and Kettlebell (KB). Follow up.

name: Wheelbarrow - Partner
instruction: Keep your arms straight through the movement, and keep your hips high not allowing them to drop. Keeping your body in a straight line, do not twist your hips.

name: ZigZag 8 - EC Side
instruction: Always face the same way throughout the movement. This means you will move forwards through the cones, remain the sameway, and move backwards back through the cones. Continue this process trying to remain low and bent knees throughout.

name: ZigZag Accel - EC
instruction: Face side on throughout the movement and ensure that your feet do not cross. The first movement is always in front of the first cone from the start.

name: ZigZag Backward - EC Side
instruction: Move backward through the cones. Focus on pushing from the outside foot and ensure that your feet don't cross over.

name: ZigZag Decel - EC
instruction: Face side on throughout the movement and ensure that your feet do not cross. The first movement is always behind the first cone from the start.

name: ZigZag Forward - EC Side
instruction: Move forward through the cones. Focus on pushing from the outside foot and ensure that your feet don't cross over.
